title: Credential at the edges of the input: must be flagged (provider-documented)
summary: A credential-shaped value stands alone, or ends the input with no trailing newline, in the shape of one provider format per input. Covers 6 inputs.
rationale: Scanners commonly anchor on delimiters. At the start and end of an input there is no delimiter, so boundary handling decides whether the value is found and whether its exact extent is right.

expectation.rationale: Source-backed lexical shape in an explicit context test; repeated shapes are not independent provider coverage.
